verdict.rationale: Chronicle Labs is a SaaS platform for agent simulation and evaluation, so opting out of its telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never documents any opt-out control. Its 'telemetry' material covers ingesting traces from the user's own agents into Chronicle, which is a product feature, not a way for users to decline vendor usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
